{{/*
Common ExternalSecret templates for next-search services
Usage: {{ include "common.externalsecret.mongodb" . }}
*/}}

{{- define "common.externalsecret.mongodb" -}}
{{- if .Values.externalSecrets.enabled }}
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-mongodb-secret
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
spec:
  secretStoreRef:
    name: {{ .Release.Name }}-secret-store
    kind: SecretStore
  target:
    name: {{ .Release.Name }}-mongodb-secret
    creationPolicy: Owner
  refreshInterval: 1h
  data:
    - secretKey: MONGO_USERNAME
      remoteRef:
        key: common-mongodb-credentials
        property: MONGO_USERNAME
    - secretKey: MONGO_PASSWORD
      remoteRef:
        key: common-mongodb-credentials
        property: MONGO_PASSWORD
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "common.externalsecret.elasticsearch-frontend" -}}
{{- if .Values.externalSecrets.enabled }}
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1

spec:
  secretStoreRef:
    name: {{ .Release.Name }}-secret-store
    kind: SecretStore
  target:
    name: {{ .Release.Name }}-elasticsearch-frontend-secret
    creationPolicy: Owner
  refreshInterval: 1h
  data:
    - secretKey: ES_FRONTEND_API_KEY
      remoteRef:
        key: common-elasticsearch-frontend-credentials
        property: ES_FRONTEND_API_KEY
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{- if .Values.externalSecrets.enabled }}

    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
spec:
  secretStoreRef:
    name: {{ .Release.Name }}-secret-store
    kind: SecretStore
  target:
    name: {{ .Release.Name }}-elasticsearch-backend-secret
    creationPolicy: Owner
  refreshInterval: 1h
  data:
    - secretKey: ES_BACKEND_API_KEY
      remoteRef:
        key: common-elasticsearch-backend-credentials
        property: ES_BACKEND_API_KEY
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "common.externalsecret.elasticsearch-dev" -}}
{{- if .Values.externalSecrets.enabled }}
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1

### 2. common 폴더 - 공용 템플릿 라이브러리

#### 2.1 `_configmap.tpl` - ConfigMap 공용 함수
다음 3가지 주요 함수 정의:

**함수 1: `common.config.elasticsearch`**
- Elasticsearch 클러스터별 환경변수 생성
- 지원 변수: HOST, PORT, CONNECT_TIMEOUT, SOCKET_TIMEOUT, CATALOG_INDEX, PRODUCT_INDEX
- 클러스터 이름으로 uppercased naming (예: ELASTICSEARCH_DEV_HOST)

**함수 2: `common.config.darae`**
- DARAE_HOST, DARAE_PORT

**함수 3: `common.config.valkey`**
- REDIS_HOST, REDIS_PORT, REDIS_MAX_CONNECTIONS, REDIS_CLUSTER_MODE

**함수 4: `common.config.mongodb`**
- MONGODB_HOST, MONGODB_PORT

**함수 5: `common.config.all` / `common.config.next`**
- 여러 설정을 조합한 종합 함수

#### 2.2 `_externalsecret.tpl` - ExternalSecret 공용 함수
6가지 시크릿 템플릿 정의:

```
- common.externalsecret.mongodb          # MONGO_USERNAME, MONGO_PASSWORD
- common.externalsecret.elasticsearch-frontend   # ES_FRONTEND_API_KEY
- common.externalsecret.elasticsearch-backend    # ES_BACKEND_API_KEY
- common.externalsecret.elasticsearch-dev       # ES_DEV_API_KEY
- common.externalsecret.valkey           # VALKEY_PASSWORD
- common.externalsecret.kafka            # KAFKA_USERNAME, KAFKA_PASSWORD
```

모두 ExternalSecrets 커스텀 리소스 사용 (external-secrets.io/v1beta1)

#### 2.3 `secretstore.yaml` - Secret 저장소 설정
- SecretStore: Kubernetes 내부 Secret을 소스로 사용
- 기본 sourceNamespace: `secret-store`
- ServiceAccount + Role + RoleBinding으로 권한 관리
- 환경변수 `externalSecrets.enabled=true`일 때만 생성
